name: get_account_summary
description: List the signed-in customer's SBI accounts (savings/current): last 4 digits, product, branch, balance, status (active/inoperative), KYC status and next KYC due date, and whether a nominee is registered.

name: get_recent_transactions
description: Get the most recent transactions (newest first, up to 10) on one of the signed-in customer's accounts: date, channel (UPI/ATM/NEFT/IMPS/RTGS/POS/NACH), amount, debit/credit, status (success, failed_pending_reversal, disputed, reversed) and reversal due date or linked complaint where relevant.

accountLast4.description: Last 4 digits of the account number, e.g. 8821

days.description: Optional look-back window in days (default 30); the newest transactions are returned first

name: get_card_status
description: Get the status of one of the signed-in customer's debit cards by its last 4 digits: active, blocked or dispatched, block date and reason, block ticket, expiry, usage settings, and replacement status.

last4.description: Last 4 digits of the debit card number, e.g. 9064

name: get_loan_details
description: Get one of the signed-in customer's loans by loan number: type (home/personal), outstanding amount, EMI, next EMI date, remaining EMIs, overdue amount and days past due, status (regular/overdue/closed) and, for closed home loans, title deed collection details.

loanNo.description: Loan account number exactly as on the sanction letter or statement, e.g. HL26004417 or PL26117820

name: get_complaint_status
description: Get the status of one of the signed-in customer's complaints by reference number: category, date lodged, current status and detail, target resolution date (resolveBy) and final decision date.

ref.description: Complaint reference number from the SMS/email acknowledgement, e.g. CRCF-261021-4471
